A chronological notification panel. New notifications stay prominent; ones you\'ve already seen recede into Earlier. Open the panel with the edge handle, the Quick Settings tile or the optional status-bar swipe — this screen is only for setup.
Turn off to hide the edge handle, status-bar swipe and lock-screen view without changing their settings. You can still open the panel from the Quick Settings tile.
Try Chronotif hands-on with made-up notifications. Your own are hidden while a part runs, and nothing you do in it reaches an app.
Your own notifications are hidden while you practise, and nothing you do here reaches an app or counts as a check.
Open the Panel, see New and Earlier, open a stack, preview a card, reply and clear.
That\'s %1$s. Tips in Settings keeps all of it in writing.
The Panel opens from Quick Settings too: open them, tap the pencil to edit, and drag Chronotif in.
Swipe down on the edge handle at the side of your screen, or tap it.
Swipe down on the edge handle at the side of your screen, or pull down from the left half of the status bar.

New holds what came since you last looked, newest first, and Earlier what you\'ve already seen. Maya is about to write again: watch her message arrive in New. Then close the Panel and open it again. What you saw has moved to Earlier.
Maya\'s messages sit in one stack, with a count. Tap it to see each message, then tap her name above them to close it again.
Press and hold a card to see all of it without opening the app. From there, reply to Maya, or snooze a card for later.
Swipe a card sideways to clear it.
Tap an empty space, press Back, or flick up at the end of the list.
Open Search from the Panel and the edge handle, ask it things, find an app, and add it to your home screen.
In the tutorial nothing opens. Otherwise %1$s would.
Open the Panel, then pull down from the top of the list. Search finds apps and answers questions, and never looks through your notifications.
Close Search and the Panel, then press and hold the edge handle. Search opens over whatever you\'re doing.
Type 12*7.5+3, 5 km in mi, or time in tokyo. The answer shows as you type, and tapping it copies it.
Type the start of an app\'s name and tap it. In the tutorial nothing opens: Search says what would.
Add the Search widget for a search bar on your home screen. You can also hold Chronotif\'s icon and pick Search, or set a launcher\'s swipe, such as Nova\'s, to open that shortcut.
With your OK, Search also finds contacts and calendar events, places calls and converts currencies. Each is a step in Search\'s checklist in Settings:
Unfold the pile, reply without unlocking, search, double-tap to sleep, hold a shortcut, and pick when it shows.
On the lock screen, this opens once you unlock.
On the lock screen, this asks you to unlock.
On the real lock screen, the display sleeps now.
Show the lock screen as it looks when the phone wakes: the clock, and New waiting at the bottom as a pile. Drag the list up to unfold it, then press Back to fold it again.
Tap the count under the pile to unfold it with New at the top. Tapping the card itself opens just that card.
Press and hold Maya\'s card and reply from its Preview. On the lock screen it sends without unlocking.
Tap the clock or the date. They open your alarms or your calendar once you unlock.
Pull down at the top for Search. Answers show without unlocking, and anything that opens an app asks you to unlock first.
Double-tap an empty space. The screen goes black for a moment: on the real lock screen, the display goes to sleep.
Double-tap to sleep is off in Settings → Lock screen.

Press and hold the button in a bottom corner. On the lock screen it turns on the flashlight, opens the camera, or whatever you set it to in Settings → Lock screen → Shortcuts. A tap only reminds you to hold.
Both shortcuts are set to None in Settings → Lock screen → Shortcuts.
On the lock screen, this turns the flashlight on or off.
On the lock screen, this opens the camera without unlocking.
On the lock screen, this opens Google Lens to scan a code once you unlock.
On the lock screen, this turns Do Not Disturb on or off.
On the lock screen, this opens your app once you unlock.
Pick when Chronotif shows on the lock screen. You can change it any time in Settings → Lock screen.
Are we still on for lunch today?
I booked the place by the river
Room 4B, with Ana, Joel and 3 more
Your parcel arrives today between 14:00 and 16:00.

Tap the edge handle or swipe down on it. With the status-bar swipe on, pull down from the left half of the status bar and the panel follows your finger. The Chronotif Quick Settings tile opens it too.
Notifications move from New to Earlier once the panel has been open for about a second and a half, or as soon as you touch it. Pulling it partway and letting it slide back doesn\'t count.

Pull down at the top of the panel or the lock-screen view, or hold the edge handle. The Search tile, widget and app shortcut open it too. It finds apps, contacts, calendar events and Settings pages, answers math, units, currencies and the time abroad, and searches the web. Settings → Search lists it all with examples.
Press and hold a card to see its full text, its picture and the app\'s buttons, without opening the app. Snooze it from there to bring it back as new later.
Tap a stack to open it, and tap its name to close it again. Swipe a card or a stack sideways to clear it.
Tap the picture in a Preview to see it full screen. Pinch to zoom, swipe sideways through a chat\'s pictures, and save them to your gallery.
Hold it until it buzzes, then drag it to either side and any height.

New waits at the bottom as a pile under the clock. Tap it or drag it up to see everything, and press Back to put it away again. Double-tap empty space to turn the screen off. Hold a button in a bottom corner for the flashlight, the camera, or the shortcut you set.
Tap an empty space, press Back, or flick up at the end of the list.
Read, open, dismiss and act on notifications.
Edge handle, and showing the lock-screen view.
Enable “Show on Lock screen” and “Display pop-up windows while running in the background”.
Required. Without it, MIUI keeps Chronotif disconnected after you clear recent apps, after a reboot, or whenever it closes Chronotif in the background.
Notification access is on, but Chronotif isn\'t connected. Tap Reconnect, then turn notification access off and on.
Notification access is on, but Chronotif isn\'t connected. Turn on Xiaomi autostart below, then tap Reconnect and turn notification access off and on once.
Greyed-out toggle? Android blocks this for sideloaded apps: open App info → ⋮ → “Allow restricted settings” (on HyperOS, the switch under Advanced settings), then try again.
Allow Notification access so Chronotif can show your notifications.
Notification access is on, but Chronotif isn\'t connected. Reconnect it below.
Allow Display over other apps so the edge handle and lock-screen view can show.
Chronotif has what it needs. Open the panel with the edge handle, the Quick Settings tile or the status-bar swipe.
Press Back again to leave settings
Each step is on or put off. The switches below change any of it.
Find people by name, with buttons to call or message them.
A contact\'s call button places the call, on WhatsApp when they use it, instead of opening the dialer.
Convert money with the European Central Bank\'s daily rates, downloaded when you type a currency. Nothing you type is sent.
Find your events by name, from the past month to a year ahead.
A search bar on your home screen, one tap from Search.
Your home screen doesn\'t let apps add widgets. Touch and hold an empty spot on it, open Widgets and find Chronotif.
Open Quick Settings, tap the pencil to edit them, and drag Chronotif Search in.
Not now. Turn it on below whenever you like.
Not now. Add it here whenever you like.

Tap or swipe down on the left half of the status bar to open Chronotif instead of the system notifications. The other half works as usual. Needs Display over other apps, and Chronotif turned on in Accessibility settings; it only uses that to place the touch area and doesn\'t read other apps\' screens.

Lets you open Chronotif by tapping or swiping down on the left half of the status bar. Chronotif uses this only to place an invisible touch area there. It doesn\'t read other apps\' screens. Turn the swipe off any time in Chronotif\'s setup.
A handle at the screen edge. Tap it or swipe down on it to open the panel, or hold it for Search. Hold and drag it to move it. It lights up when something is new, and steps aside in fullscreen apps.
With count, the handle shows how many notifications are new, to anyone who can see your screen.

The clock and date at the top of the panel. Tap the clock to open your alarms, the date to open your calendar, or the gear to open your phone\'s settings. 12/24-hour time and the date\'s order follow your phone\'s settings.
Type an app\'s name, or any word in it: \"music\" finds YouTube Music. Before you type, the apps that notified most recently are there.
5 km in mi · 30 c · 2 lb in kg
100 usd · $20 · rp 50.000 to sgd. Needs Currency rates on.
A name or three digits of a number, with buttons to call or message, on WhatsApp too. Needs Find contacts on.
An event\'s title, from a month ago to a year ahead. Needs Find calendar events on.
Anything else opens in your browser with the engine below.
Search never looks through your notifications, and nothing you type leaves the phone unless you tap the web row. Tapping an answer copies it.
Pull down at the top of the panel or lock-screen view to open Search. It also opens from a long press on the edge handle, the Search tile, the Search widget and the app icon\'s shortcut.
A round button that opens Chronotif\'s Search
A search bar that opens Chronotif\'s Search
Search lists matching contacts, with buttons to call or message them. Contacts are read only on this phone. They show while it\'s locked, unless the lock screen hides sensitive content.
A contact\'s call button places the call: a WhatsApp call when they\'re on WhatsApp, with a video call button too, otherwise a phone call. Off, the call button opens the dialer with the number ready.
Search lists matching events from the past month to a year ahead. Events are read only on this phone. They show while it\'s locked, unless the lock screen hides sensitive content.
Allow the permission in Chronotif\'s app info to turn this on.
Tap to turn on. Chronotif downloads the European Central Bank\'s daily rates when you type a currency and newer ones are out. Nothing you type is sent.
Getting the European Central Bank\'s rates…
Couldn\'t get exchange rates. Check your connection and type again.
European Central Bank rate, %1$s · Tap to copy

Search converts currencies (100 usd, $20, rp 50.000 to sgd) with the European Central Bank\'s daily reference rates. They\'re downloaded only when you type a currency and the bank has published newer ones than you have, which it does on working days around 16:00 in Frankfurt. Nothing you type is sent.
Anything Search can\'t answer goes to your default browser with this engine. Chronotif itself sends nothing you type.
You can also add the “Chronotif” tile to Quick Settings.

Always hide content on the lock screen. When off, Chronotif follows the system setting and each app\'s privacy choice. Replies and buttons that don\'t open an app work without unlocking, unless the app asks for it. Opening an app always requires unlocking. Hiding content also hides contacts and events in Search while locked.

Double-tap empty space to turn the screen off, as on your phone\'s own lock screen. It goes black at once, and the phone sleeps a few seconds later. When off, a single tap asks to unlock without the short wait for a second tap.
Press and hold a button in a bottom corner of the lock screen to use it. The camera opens without unlocking; the QR scanner and apps ask you to unlock first.

Your phone\'s haptic feedback is off, so holding a shortcut doesn\'t vibrate. The button still grows while you hold it. To feel it, turn on Haptic feedback in your phone\'s Sound & vibration settings.
The flashlight can\'t turn on while the camera is in use.
No camera app opens over the lock screen.
Do Not Disturb needs Chronotif\'s notification access.
That app isn\'t installed any more. Pick another in Settings → Lock screen.
Not available without Google Lens. Chronotif scans with Lens, which reads codes better than any other scanner on Android.
Scan from Quick Settings too, with the Chronotif QR scanner tile.
Your phone has its fingerprint sensor under the screen, so the lock screen keeps the pile and Tap to unlock above it. Touch the sensor once to fit that room to it exactly.
If your fingerprint sensor is under the screen, touch it once so the lock screen keeps the pile and Tap to unlock above it. A sensor on the side or the back needs nothing.
The lock screen keeps the pile and Tap to unlock above your fingerprint sensor, fitted to where you touched it.
Rest your finger on it, the way you do to unlock, then lift it.
That\'s too high for a fingerprint sensor. Touch the sensor near the bottom of the screen.
My sensor isn\'t under the screen
The lock screen now keeps clear of your sensor.

No accounts. Notifications never leave this device. Stored on it: the time of your last check, when the last few apps notified (never what they said), these settings, and Usage data waiting to be sent. Chronotif goes online for three things: the update check below, off until you turn it on; Search\'s currency rates, downloaded from the European Central Bank when you type a currency; and Usage data, which you can turn off here.

Send anonymous counts, Panel speeds, settings and crash reports, so Chronotif can be improved from how it\'s really used. Never anything from your notifications, contacts, calendar or Search. Turning it off sends one last note that it was turned off, then nothing.
Every field Usage data sends, listed on GitHub.
Anonymous counts, Panel speeds, settings and crash reports. Never anything from your notifications. Change it any time in Privacy and about.

Once a day, when you\'re on Wi-Fi and the battery isn\'t low, check GitHub Releases for a new version and install it. Android asks you to confirm unless “Install unknown apps” is allowed for Chronotif.
Lets updates install without asking each time (Android 12+).

See what\'s new on GitHub Releases.
The update is signed with a different key than this install. Uninstall and install it manually from GitHub Releases.
Nightly includes changes still being tested. Switching to Stable waits for a newer stable release; it does not downgrade the app.
